title.zh: Lloyds completes first stablecoin settlement pilot with Visa using USDC
title.en: Lloyds completes first stablecoin settlement pilot with Visa using USDC

current_state.zh: Lloyds Banking Group completed its first stablecoin settlement pilot with Visa, using USDC purchased through regulated exchange Archax to settle $750,000 of payment obligations, with funds reaching Visa in under an hour including over a weekend.
